title: boeica tonkinensis
intro: Boeica tonkinensis, commonly known as Tonkin blue forget-me-not, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gesneriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine in Vietnam to treat various health issues, including fever, headache, and respiratory problems, due to its impressive health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Boeica tonkinensis include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
